crossRefs.note: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame.
My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.
It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a…
My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
“Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.
They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
Whereas you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears…
so am I made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
“My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct, and the grave is ready for me.
As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions…
Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

translations.web: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
translations.bsb: My dwelling has been picked up and removed from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver; He cuts me off from the loom; from day until night You make an end of me.
translations.kjv: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end
translations.asv: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me as a shepherd's tent: I have rolled up, like a weaver, my life; he will cut me off from the loom: From day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
